Main sole executor under owned measurement lock. Full source/hash/diff review first; apply separate worktree; free+contrib-llvm sourceLLVM7.1.1 build and mandatory lints, CPU regressions for production wrapper. Verify SYCL installed get_kernel_bundle/has_kernel/pointer query signatures and source-compatible profiling aspect. No GPU CTest registered.
Fresh nativeinteger health/identity/fault cursors before and after each actual diagnostic process. Main bounded owner pinned SHAa29d8257... with finite wall<=300s/cell, log<=64MiB,total<=96MiB,RSS<=4GiB,CPU cap affinity-based; no overlapping GPU jobs. Selected Runtime source/device/provider/library/binary pins Main supplies. No unattended loops or retries. Capture all ten shape/NT cells as separate statuses/commands/env/bounds/host and event fields; startup/build diagnostics distinct from runtime faults. Exit77 means profiling/sharedUSM unavailable, never PASS. Bundle errors mean XMX unavailable/FAILED, retain diagnostic; do not force unsupported XMX. Actual fallback may be separately selected through existing Main-reviewed environment and must name backend.
Review output reference sensitivity and permitted tolerance. Add independent random operand sampled-column CPU dot checks if broader precision coverage required; current full-array structured check covers groups/tails/NT but not arbitrary distributions. Verify allocation failure/null/bounds/origin/nonmonotonic/max overflow/queue mismatch rejects before kernel; allocation extents remain caller contract. Inject host async-latch fixture only if available, and prove failed-drain failstop cannot emit PASS. Inspect actual exact-kernel bundle record/backend with event complete/start/end. No barrier substitution, no profiling productionqueue mutation. Final runtime queue drain and fresh faultgate required before qualification. Quiet real-model endpoint and logit parity are separate future gates, not inferred from synthetic times. Compare Main original source unchanged production calls/empty no-op/nonnull async/null stream wait semantics, cross-device source fix if relevant.
